scope: Role, orientation and data-* of the web component in happy-dom and of the React renderer in react-dom/server (node:test), and their state parity. Rendered thickness is covered by the browser geometry check; visual quality and screen-reader output are not certified.
limitations: React styling parity is checked in the browser: apps/studio/react-check.html compares the React Chart with ui-chart at five sizes ("fails": []).
The source list is the direct sources, not every transitive dependency.
